written: 2026-11-14 ~20:15 IST, before any v21 model was trained or scored (recipe revised once at ~20:15 from public write-ups, still before any training)
question: Does replacing ConvNeXt-B in the shipped set A with a ViT-B/16 (AugReg2, ImageNet-21k pretraining) improve pooled five-fold out-of-fold AUC without hurting robustness?
motivation: ConvNeXt-B is the weakest set-A member (pooled clean 0.8815). Public Synergy '26 write-ups report this ViT-B checkpoint as their strongest single backbone on their own grouped folds. Our earlier ViT-B/16 try used torchvision ImageNet-1k weights, not this checkpoint. A third public write-up reports pooled OOF 0.907 for this ViT-B (6 epochs, backbone lr 3e-5, head 3e-4) and 0.907 for EfficientNetV2-S on its own folds.
reference: set A = cnxt22k + swin22k + maxvit + cnxt_base (outputs/ablations/v20/pooled_oof.json)

all_of: pooled mean AUC over the 22 default views gain >= +0.0010
T4 estimate <= 240 s, scaled from the measured 202.1 s cold by per-image GFLOPs of the members (each refit at seeds 42 and 7)
ship_rule.if_pass: refit the new members on all rows at seeds 42 and 7 (fixed.pt at each member's save_at epoch), build a bundle with cnxt_base replaced, rerun inference twice (byte-identical), check_predictions, Spearman vs shipped v20 predictions >= 0.95 (broken-model gate only), re-time on a T4 before shipping
ship_rule.choice: if both pass, ship the one with higher pooled clean AUC; if within 0.0005, ship the cheaper (V)

results.scored: 2026-11-14, five-fold OOF logits of vit21k and effv2s (one run per fold, as registered); set-A member logits reused from v20; AUC method validated against the four recorded v20 set-A numbers to < 1e-9. Full table in outputs/ablations/v21/pooled_oof_v21.json.
results.decision: Neither V nor V2 passes the ship rule: both fail the primary clean-AUC gain (>= +0.0015; both are negative), and V2 also misses the default-mean gain. Although vit21k and effv2s are much stronger single members than cnxt_base, the set-A members are already strong and correlated, so swapping in a more-correlated member does not lift the fused clean AUC. Shipping the v20 bundle unchanged, as pre-registered under if_fail. No bundle rebuilt, no inference-script change, no T4 re-timing (gates did not pass). The effv2s seed-42 refit OOM failure on user7 is moot (effv2s not shipped).

vit21k.recipe: v20 recipe flags (ema 0.99, label smoothing 0.05, aug strong, conflict drop, mosaic 0.5/16, sbi 0.15, paired_target_mix 0.5, bs 48, seed 42) with epochs 6, save_at 6, lr 3e-4, backbone_lr_mult 0.1

effv2s.recipe: same flags with epochs 12, save_at 11, lr 5e-4, backbone_lr_mult 0.2

folds: split_v1.csv (fold 0) and split_v1_fold1..4.csv, fixed.pt scored with outputs/ablations/v14/score_views.py; one run per fold, no second attempt scored against this rule
